features.name: Creve Coeur Lake
features.description: The 320-acre Creve Coeur Lake supports paddling, sailing and fishing under posted rules; ordinary swimming is not allowed and water conditions can close access.

details.positionQuality: Creve Coeur Lake, Maryland Heights, Saint Louis County, Missouri, United States
details.imageAlt: Creve Coeur Lake at Creve Coeur Lake Memorial Park

features.name: Lakeview Loop Trail
features.description: The roughly 3.8-mile paved Lakeview Loop is a flat shared route around the lake with substantial sun exposure, busy weekend traffic and several shoreline access points.

details.positionQuality: Lakeview Loop Trail, Maryland Heights, Saint Louis County, Missouri, 64043, United States
details.imageAlt: Lakeview Loop Trail at Creve Coeur Lake Memorial Park

features.name: Sailboat Cove
features.description: Sailboat Cove is the primary lower-lake arrival for boating, rentals, shelters and shoreline activity; parking fills quickly during races and warm weekends.

details.imageAlt: Sailboat Cove at Creve Coeur Lake Memorial Park

features.name: Mallard Lake
features.description: Mallard Lake is a smaller wetland and fishing destination connected to the larger trail system, with quieter habitat and flood-sensitive approaches.

features.name: Creve Coeur Connector Trail
features.description: Creve Coeur Connector Trail climbs from the lake system toward regional greenway and Missouri River connections, adding distance and grade beyond the lake loop.
